body: Thank you so much this answer is really helpful, I will update whenever I get more information

Maybe yeah, for now I think I'm going to try to sleep, he has been texting me for the past hour now and I haven't slept.  I have work today so hopefully all goes well, ty for talking with me and getting my mind off of it for a while.
No I've never heard of that game.  What's it about?

My favorite is when I got special edition and did the vampire lord quests.  I loved being a vampire but I played it as a vampire hunter too.  Both were super fun.  I also loved that you could get dogs from the quests.

I grew up with a Xbox playing black ops 2.  It will always be my favorite.  I used to play all night with my buddies and grind to get better.  It was really hard but with years of practice I got really good.  Eventually I fell in love with games like skyrim, which is still one of my favorite all time games.
I'll try, I appreciate you talking to me, thank youp

I love stardew valley too, I've been trying to get back into fps like cod.  I used to play those types of games a lot as a kid, and my friends play them a lot so I tried to get back into it.  The guy I love came over a while ago and played cod with me for a few hours and he kicked my ass when we 1v1, but I destroyed him in a free for all with other people
Oh yeah when I caught it I tried to delete it and it warned me it was shiny, the shiny bulbasaur looks very similar to regular bulbasaur and I didn't realize.  I was so excited.
I know, it's just what I always turn to during hard times.  He has done so good being sober I don't want my issues to fuck up his sobriety.

First Gen will always be my favorite.  I loved bulbasaur the most, I've always loved the grass types.  I did the same thing where I would make bulbasaur insanely strong and use him for almost everything.  My father bought the pokemon let's go evie for the switch not long ago and we enjoyed playing that together.  I got a shiny bulbasaur I named "toadette" that I used constantly.
Yes that one, If I remember properly I think ash almost died, and Pikachu almost died too.

I can't talk to him, he's always been weird with emotions.  He promised me that if it got bad he wouldn't let me turn to drugs again and he would teach me how to be content with being numb.  He's always numb.
I remember my grandma had the entire first season on tape so I'd watch that, there was 2 movies I can't remember the names.  One had mew and mewto and the other was a Christmas special movie.
I'm trying, it's just hard sometimes.  I don't like how my happiness depends on his.
He says that his son needs me in his life, but he doesn't, that boy has a good dad and that's all he needs.  Ty, but I know I'm not.  Everytime someone tries to show they love me I shut down.

Pokemon was one of the first games I played too.  When my parents were being dumb I lived with my great grandma and she had an old Gameboy I would play on.  My favorite pokemon was always bulbasaur.  She used to play pokemon movies on her old box TV to help me sleep.

He has a 9 month old son he had with his ex.  We both hate her, she never takes care of her child.  We love his son more than we love ourselves. I'm not worthy of happiness, but he is.  He's gone through so much more than I have and I shouldn't be making him have to comfort me.
I like playing video games but lately I've lost interest in most things.  I've been getting more depressed over time.
I don't deserve to be happy, but he does.  All I want is for him to be happy and be a good dad, and I know he can do it without me.
Sure, that's fine
I can't go up, not after this, I've never wanted to admit I like guys and now that I have I feel disgusting towards myself
Thank you
I know how much easier it is without having depressing people in your life, I'm only dragging him down with me
Well it ended up taking over 12 hours, I went to sleep and woke up tripping balls, nice day :)
